Lattice Deck

A programmable presentation and live graphics workbench with scripted agents, hosted model access and collaboration rooms.

This is a working imported proof of concept. The original visual design is preserved.

Model calls use the shared hosting limits. Start with the default example; advanced workflows may require additional configuration.

Procedural 3D: a colored heightfield and parametric shell generated from JavaScript.
Animated 3D: a rotating knot, shader-driven blob and live surface with controls.
Sample revenue by region displayed as stacked bars in a presentation slide.
